request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real skin, fabric, building and landscape texture, natural light and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

Image 1 shows Luis: about thirty, short curly black hair, a navy T-shirt. Keep his face, hair and clothes exactly. Create a NEW photograph: Luis DRIVES a car. He sits in the driver's seat with his seat belt on and both hands on the steering wheel, looking ahead at the road through the windshield; he is seen from the front passenger seat, so his face in profile, the steering wheel and the road ahead through the windshield are all plainly visible. The car is moving along a street in daylight. Exactly one person; no phone. No letters, words, numbers, logos, badges with writing or brand marks anywhere. Every visible hand has five natural fingers.

cost.basis: Reported usage at list prices checked 2026-09-24; before tax, not an invoice.
